notes:
Account snapshot: sprintminds builds realtime personalization and conversational flows for a European neo-bank. Very latency- and cost-sensitive — product team wants p50 ~30-50ms, p95 <100ms, p99 <150ms for primary chat and reranking routes. Workloads: mix of short-context chat (avg 60 tokens), multi-turn personalization with KV caches, and reranking pipelines that run 3-6 models per request.

Key asks:
- Benchmark plan: run Redwood Dedicated perf sweeps vs their current on-prem infra (NVIDIA A10x -> potential jump to A100 p4) with 10k–50k sample queries, measure p50/p95/p99 and tokens/sec.
- Cost targets: unit cost must improve vs current infra; looking for quantization options (int8/4-bit) + batching guidance to reduce token cost without hurting latency SLO.
- Caching: aggressive prefix/KV cache for multi-turn personalization; want demo of transparent cache hit/miss metrics.
- Fallbacks/routing: need routing policy for cheaper model variants during bursts; can Redwood provide automatic fallback to quantized variant?

Customer quotes (paraphrased): "We can tolerate slightly lower generation quality in reranking as long as latency/tco improves." — Head of ML.

Sales notes: POC will be the main close lever. Procurement is price-sensitive; security is non-negotiable (EU residency + SOC2). SE to run perf benchmark the week of 2026-03-22. Provide prompt set (10k) and traffic distribution by 2026-03-15.
